web.title: 2025 - The Nebula Awards®
web.description:
## 2025 Nebula Awards®
#### [Best Novel](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/award/best-novel/)
- [_When We Were Real, by Daryl Gregory (Saga)_](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/when-we-were-real-by-daryl-gregory-saga/)
- **Winner:** [_The Buffalo Hunter Hunter, by Stephen Graham Jones (Saga; Titan UK)_](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/the-buffalo-hunter-hunter-by-stephen-graham-jones-saga-titan-uk/)
- [_Katabasis, by R.F. Kuang (Harper Voyager US; Harper Voyager UK)_](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/katabasis-by-r-f-kuang-harper-voyager-us-harper-voyager-uk/)
- [_Death of the Author, by Nnedi Okorafor (Morrow; Gollancz)_](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/death-of-the-author-by-nnedi-okorafor-morrow-gollancz/)
- [_The Incandescent, by Emily Tesh (Tor; Orbit UK)_](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/the-incandescent-by-emily-tesh-tor-orbit-uk/)
- [_Sour Cherry, by Natalia Theodoridou (Tin House; Wildfire)_](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/sour-cherry-by-natalia-theodoridou-tin-house-wildfire/)
- [_Wearing the Lion, by John Wiswell (DAW; Arcadia)_](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/wearing-the-lion-by-john-wiswell-daw-arcadia/)

#### [Best Novella](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/award/best-novella/)
- [“Disgraced Return of the Kap’s Needle, by Renan Bernardo (Dark Matter INK)”](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/disgraced-return-of-the-kaps-needle-by-renan-bernardo-dark-matter-ink/)
- **Winner:** [“The River Has Roots, by Amal El-Mohtar (Tordotcom; Arcadia)”](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/9203/)
- [“The Death of Mountains, by Jordan Kurella (Lethe)”](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/the-death-of-mountains-by-jordan-kurella-lethe/)
- [“Automatic Noodle, by Annalee Newitz (Tordotcom)”](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/automatic-noodle-by-annalee-newitz-tordotcom/)
- [“But Not Too Bold, by Hache Pueyo (Tordotcom)”](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/but-not-too-bold-by-hache-pueyo-tordotcom/)
- [““Descent”, by Wole Talabi (Clarkesworld 5/25)”](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/descent-by-wole-talabi-clarkesworld-5-25/)

#### [Best Novelette](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/award/best-novelette/)
- [““Our Echoes Drifting Through the Marsh”, by Marie Croke (Beneath Ceaseless Skies 1/9/25)”](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/our-echoes-drifting-through-the-marsh-by-marie-croke-beneath-ceaseless-skies-1-9-25/)
- **Winner:** [““Uncertain Sons”, by Thomas Ha (Uncertain Sons)”](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/uncertain-sons-by-thomas-ha-uncertain-sons/)
- [““We Begin Where Infinity Ends”, by Somto Ihezue (Clarkesworld 2/25)”](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/we-begin-where-infinity-ends-by-somto-ihezue-clarkesworld-2-25/)
- [“The Name Ziya, by Wen-Yi Lee (Tor)”](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/the-name-ziya-by-wen-yi-lee-tor/)
- [““Never Eaten Vegetables”, by H.H. Pak (Clarkesworld 1/25)”](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/never-eaten-vegetables-by-h-h-pak-clarkesworld-1-25/)
- [““The Life and Times of Alavira the Great as Written by Titos Pavlou and Reviewed by Two Lifelong Friends”, by Eugenia Triantafyllou (Uncanny 3-4/25)”](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/the-life-and-times-of-alavira-the-great-as-written-by-titos-pavlou-and-reviewed-by-two-lifelong-friends-by-eugenia-triantafyllou-uncanny-3-4-25/)

#### [Best Short Story](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/award/best-short-story/)
- [““Through the Machine”, by P.A. Cornell (Lightspeed 5/25)”](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/through-the-machine-by-p-a-cornell-lightspeed-5-25/)
- [““Six People to Revise You”, by J.R. Dawson (Uncanny 1-2/25)”](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/six-people-to-revise-you-by-j-r-dawson-uncanny-1-2-25/)
- [““The Tawlish Island Songbook of the Dead”, by E.M. Linden (PodCastle 2/18/25)”](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/the-tawlish-island-songbook-of-the-dead-by-e-m-linden-podcastle-2-18-25/)
- [““In My Country”, by Thomas Ha (Clarkesworld 4/25)”](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/in-my-country-by-thomas-ha-clarkesworld-4-25/)
- [““Because I Held His Name Like a Key”, by Aimee Ogden (Strange Horizons 6/16/25)”](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/because-i-held-his-name-like-a-key-by-aimee-ogden-strange-horizons-6-16-25/)
- **Winner:** [““Laser Eyes Ain’t Everything”, by Effie Seiberg (Diabolical Plots 5/25)”](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/laser-eyes-aint-everything-by-effie-seiberg-diabolical-plots-5-25/)

#### [Andre Norton Nebula Award for Middle Grade and Young Adult Fiction](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/award/andre-norton-award/)
- [_The Tower, by David Anaxagoras (Recorded Books)_](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/the-tower-by-david-anaxagoras-recorded-books/)
- **Winner:** [_Into the Wild Magic, by Michelle Knudsen (Candlewick)_](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/into-the-wild-magic-by-michelle-knudsen-candlewick/)

#### [Best Comic](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/award/best-comic/)
- [Second Shift, by Kit Anderson (Avery Hill)](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/second-shift-by-kit-anderson-avery-hill/)
- [Carmilla Volume 3: The Eternal, by Amy Chu (Berger)](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/carmilla-volume-3-the-eternal-by-amy-chu-berger/)
- [Fishflies, by Jeff Lemire (Image)](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/fishflies-by-jeff-lemire-image/)
- **Winner:** [Mary Shelley’s School for Monsters: The Killing Stone, by Jessica Maison (Wicked Tree)](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/mary-shelleys-school-for-monsters-the-killing-stone-by-jessica-maison-wicked-tree/)
- [The Flip Side, by Jason Walz (Rocky Pond)](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/the-flip-side-by-jason-walz-rocky-pond/)
- [The Stoneshore Register, by G. Willow Wilson (Berger)](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/the-stoneshore-register-by-g-willow-wilson-berger/)

#### [Best Poem](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/award/best-poem/)
- **Winner:** [“The World To Come”, by Jennifer Hudak (Strange Horizons 12/22/25)](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/the-world-to-come-by-jennifer-hudak-strange-horizons-12-22-25/)
- [“To Be the Change”, by Nico Martinez Nocito (Strange Horizons 3/10/25)](https://nebulas.sfwa.org/nominated-work/to-be-the-change-by-nico-martinez-nocito-strange-horizons-3-10-25/)
